messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: hosted-api-us-east queue length rising rapidly (12,400 reqs). GPU pool us-east-1a at 100% alloc, autoscaler failing to provision new GPU instances (api error 503). p95 latency 2.3s, p99 latency 9.1s, and 1.8% 504s in last 5m. Paging oncall.
sre-oncall: I’m on it. grabbing metrics and checking autoscaler logs. tagging infra-eng.
infra-eng: looking, I see provisioner returning rate-limit errors from cloud provider on instance create: 
```
ERROR: quotaExceeded: Cannot allocate requested GPUs, requestId=xyz123
```
This looks like cloud quota or transient API throttling.
mike: can we temporary shift traffic to dedicated pools or lower-SLA model variants?
amy: support, are we seeing customer tickets? any high-tier customers impacted?
support: a couple of customers reported timeouts for inference calls, one enterprise (ACME) opened a ticket, marked P1. They’re seeing elevated error rates.
jen: immediate mitigations: 1) enable global soft-rate-limit to shed extra bursty clients; 2) route non-critical traffic to small-quantized model variants (gpt-lite) with lower GPU needs; 3) attempt manual scale by provisioning spare preemptible GPU nodes in eu region and cross-region route if acceptable.
sre-oncall: executing step 1 now: applying temporary rate-limit 15rps global via edge controller.
```
# edgectl
edgectl rate-limit set --scope=hosted-api --limit=15rps --reason="emergency backlog"
```
infra-eng: cloud provider is returning 429s on create. I’m opening a quota escalation with provider and also trying a manual create in us-east-1b (different AZ).
jen: step 2 rolling: changing default model route for anonymous/low-tier to gpt-quantized-1 (best-effort). will patch routing config.
sre-oncall: rate-limit in effect. queue length stabilized but still high: 12.4k -> 7.9k in 3m. p95 down to 1.5s, p99 to 4.6s. still seeing timeouts from older queued requests.
amy: update support: tell ACME we’re mitigating GPU shortage, enabling degraded routing to keep service up, ETA for resolution 30–45m while we get new nodes or redirects fully effective.
support: sending message to ACME: "We’ve applied temporary safeguards and are routing some requests to quantized models to reduce errors. We’ll update in 30m."
mike: can we evict non-customer/background batch jobs from hosted pools?
infra-eng: yes, identifying batch jobs. killing low-priority batch queue now. // calling reclaim API
```
rictl jobs cancel --filter=priority:low --pool=hosted-us-east
```
sre-oncall: cancelled ~150 low-priority jobs, freed ~2 GPUs. queue back to 5.1k, p95 1.0s, p99 2.2s. error rate falling but spikes remain for large-request customers.
jen: if autoscaler still can't create, we should enable cross-region fallback for traffic to eu and asia pools for read-only or best-effort workloads. need approvals for cross-region data egress for some customers.
amy: I’ll surface cross-region opt-in to affected enterprise contacts. pushing opt-in prompts to their consoles.
infra-eng: provider accepted one manual GPU create in us-east-1b, but it's slow (10m). attempting 2 more.
sre-oncall: timeline: rate-limits + eviction + quantized routing improved baseline. manual node creates in progress. continuing to monitor.
amy: postmortem checklist capture: exact timeline, autoscaler failure root cause (provider throttling vs internal bug), customer impact list and notifications, follow-ups: increase cloud GPU quota, add warm standby pools, improve autoscaler retry/backoff.
support: ACME acknowledged mitigation, wants postmortem and SLA credits if lapse > 30m. logging ticket.
incident-bot: INCIDENT NOTE: Sev2 - Hosted API - GPU capacity exhaustion & autoscaler provisioning failures. participants: sre-oncall, infra-eng, jen, mike, amy, support. root_ts=8421356789
sre-oncall: closing note: manual nodes up, traffic mostly stable, queue 600, p95 220ms, p99 520ms. I’ll remain monitoring for next 60m and then hand off to next oncall.
jen: reassign follow-ups: infra to file cloud quota limit increase (GCP case 98765), eng to add autoscaler backoff patch, product to update docs about cross-region fallbacks.
amy: thanks all. will coordinate customer comms and SLAs.
support: logging follow-up tasks in the ACME ticket and the incidents backlog.
sre-oncall: switching channel to eng-incidents for postmortem write-up in 30m. end of thread.
